description: Open-source implementation of JPEG2000 Part-15 (or JPH or HTJ2K)

latest_release.body:
Many changes has occurred since the last release.
Many thanks to all those who contributed.
There is a small API change.

## What's Changed
* Fix ends of the encoding LUT of LUT-style NLTs by @palemieux in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/376
* Fix comment on ft_min and ft_max in nlt_rec by @michaeldsmith in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/378
* Group CodeQL GitHub Actions bumps in Dependabot by @cary-ilm in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/385
* Bump github/codeql-action/autobuild from 4.38.0 to 4.38.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/382
* Bump github/codeql-action/init from 4.38.0 to 4.38.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/381
* Bump github/codeql-action/analyze from 4.38.0 to 4.38.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/380
* Bump the codeql group with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/386
* Issues/0377 implement nonuniformly sampled inverse lut by @michaeldsmith in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/379
* Fix heap buffer overflow in OpenJPH NLT marker parsing by @cary-ilm in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/384
* Fix null-pointer dereference in DFS-index lookup by @cary-ilm in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/383
* Bump the codeql group with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/387
* Bump uraimo/run-on-arch-action from 3.2.0 to 3.2.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/394
* Bump msys2/setup-msys2 from 2.32.0 to 2.33.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/393
* Work around MSVC x86 internal compiler error in the AVX2 encoder by @Kiptoo-Deus in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/395
* Revert "Bump msys2/setup-msys2 from 2.32.0 to 2.33.0" by @aous72 in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/400
* A bug fix and a small change to NLT4 by @aous72 in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/392
* Add quantization weighting by @aous72 in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/398
* This fixes an issue for older version of glibc 2.34. by @aous72 in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/399
* Bump actions/upload-artifact from 7.0.1 to 7.0.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/402
* Bump the codeql group with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/403
* Don't use SSE2 into SSE code (fix build buid for i686) by @carlo-bramini in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/404
* replace << with *2 by @vlazar-ilm in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/405
* Fixes issues/bugs by @aous72 in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/412
* Bump the codeql group with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/411
* Bump the codeql group with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/414
* Accept uppercase .PGM/.PPM input in ojph_compress by @NotAFlightRisk in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/407
* Fix uninitialized reads in NLT marker parsing by @Carmel0 in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/413
* Fixes CVE-2026-111151 by @aous72 in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/415

## New Contributors
* @Kiptoo-Deus made their first contribution in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/395
* @carlo-bramini made their first contribution in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/404
* @vlazar-ilm made their first contribution in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/405
* @NotAFlightRisk made their first contribution in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/407
* @Carmel0 made their first contribution in https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/pull/413

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/aous72/OpenJPH/compare/0.32.0...0.33.0

detail.readme:
[![Join the chat at https://gitter.im/OpenJPH](https://badges.gitter.im/OpenJPH.svg)](https://gitter.im/OpenJPH?utm_source=badge&utm_medium=badge&utm_campaign=pr-badge&utm_content=badge)

# Readme #

Open source implementation of High-throughput JPEG2000 (HTJ2K), also known as JPH, JPEG2000 Part 15, ISO/IEC 15444-15, and ITU-T T.814. Here, we are interested in implementing the HTJ2K only, supporting features that are defined in JPEG2000 Part 1 (for example, for wavelet transform, only reversible 5/3 and irreversible 9/7 are supported).

The interested reader is referred to the [short HTJ2K white paper](https://ds.jpeg.org/whitepapers/jpeg-htj2k-whitepaper.pdf), or the [extended HTJ2K white paper](https://htj2k.com/wp-content/uploads/white-paper.pdf) for more details on HTJ2K. [This](https://kakadusoftware.com/wp-content/uploads/icip2019.pdf) paper explores the attainable performance on CPU, while [this](https://kakadusoftware.com/wp-content/uploads/ICIP2019_GPU.pdf) and [this](https://hdl.handle.net/1959.4/unsworks_75139) explores performance on the GPU.

# The standard #

The standard is available free of charge from [ITU website](https://www.itu.int/rec/T-REC-T.814/en). It can also be purchased from the [ISO website](https://www.iso.org/standard/76621.html).
